purpose: Describe matched GA and ES prefixes for comparison with the resource-limited PPO development trajectory; no new trials
scope: First four phases of two previously completed full-budget development trials
selection: Use records [0:800] and centroid checkpoint entries with task_idx 0..3. Remove zero_shot_next_returns from phase 3 because the next phase lies outside this prefix. Preserve original files unchanged.
metric_definitions: Reuse shinka_crl.analysis.summarize_trial and its integrate_curve: LA averages four own-task means; signed F averages own[i]-previous[i+1] over three switches; ZT averages next[i] over phases 0..2; LA-F retains the sign of F.
cumulative_clock: Completed-generation steps, 768000 nominal steps per generation, pinned unit NE-generation trapezoidal grid with the first logged return extended to time zero; this is not an untrained-agent measurement.
normalization: Divide cumulative reward-steps by 614400000 and the 500-step episode cap; distinct from the paper's reference-dependent rescaling.
compute_accounting: No new training or evaluation. Prefix runtime is the original parent-observed monotonic elapsed time at the fourth phase checkpoint; the full original training, analysis, and suite costs remain incurred and are reported separately, not charged again. Prefix peak RSS was not measured separately. Derivation performs file verification and arithmetic only; its duration is not measured.
uncertainty: One development trajectory per method; no estimate of between-trial variation and no final reporting or full-budget three-method ranking.
verification: Verify every published source hash and every frozen harness file against the declared immutable Git source archive, then baseline configuration, native evaluator hashes, full twenty-phase metrics, matched task vectors, and selected phase boundaries. Archive identity does not depend on current worktree bytes. The separately recorded calculation implementation remains part of this derivation's provenance.

ga.source_archive_basis: Recorded clean runtime harness commit; all twelve frozen source hashes verified against this archive

es.source_archive_basis: Content-equivalent source archive verified against all twelve frozen hashes; the original runtime HEAD was not recorded and is not asserted here
